decision_rule.not_ready: Any required partition is older than 2026-10-27, the column is not materialized, or composite coverage is below 99%. Missing/stale values are not current signals.
decision_rule.ready: All three R257 partitions have a date=2026-10-27 partition, the real attach_ext_columns path materializes the composite column, and at least 99% of current HS300 members with a 2026-10-27 market row have non-null composite values.

hypothesis: The production path can attach R257 only on an exact (symbol,date) match. If the existing R257 composite table is stale, the current-session cross-section is unavailable even when the code and historical factor values are valid.
limits: No forward returns or historical trade outcomes may be read.
No backtest, signal ranking, paper execution, order, or production gate change.
No provider calls, synchronization, factor builder, market-data writes, or ext-data writes.
Temporary scratch files are removed by TemporaryDirectory on normal completion.
method: Read the current-members cache and latest enriched daily partition; copy only the byte-identical latest partitions for the three R257 tables and their one-field configs into a temporary scratch data_dir; call production app.factors.ext_factors.attach_ext_columns(..., include_snapshot=False) on the current-member market rows; count exact-date non-null coverage. Record SHA-256 for source/code inputs and output.
panel_capacity_note: The panel currently has six entries; backend CandidateStore permits up to 200. A pending candidate documents a research diagnostic and is not authorization to execute its config as a backtest.
question: Can the production extended-factor attachment path produce an auditable, same-date, non-null R257 cross-section for the latest market session among current HS300 constituents?
